Need determine if core story text contains role and means. Role is after "As a". Means is "I want to ...". In user story format. If role absent or means absent = violation. Some stories may have malformed role? Need decide. Role can be identified even weird "a anonymoususer" gives role. Means can be identified even if rambling? Need if no I want? Most have.

Let's list all 69. Need evaluate. Criterion: includes at least role and means. Violation when either stakeholder role or requested functionality cannot be identified from core story text.

Need output exactly 69 objects. Need evidence short text. Can use empty if no violation? Provide evidence. Need related_story_ids [] unless set-level, not. Confidence.

We must judge each story.

Let's parse each:

BC-001: As a anonymoususer, I want to view a list of sponsors, so that I can thank all the awesome sponsors.
Role: anonymoususer. Means: view list of sponsors. No violation.

BC-002: As a anonymoususer, I want to view a list of user profiles, so that I know who is attending. Role yes, means yes.

BC-003: As a trainingcoordinator, I want to email all the trainers at once from the website for info and updates, so that It is easier to use.
Role yes trainingcoordinator. Means: email trainers. No violation.

BC-004: As a attendee, I want to have a very clear map where buildings/rooms are, so that I can make it to class on time. Role yes, means yes.

BC-005: As a trainer, I want to edit my training node myself, so that training coordinators don't have to and links to slides.
Role trainer. Means: edit my training node. Yes.

BC-006: As a trainee, I want to limit to one registration per day per authenticated user, so that we don't have duplicate spaces.
Role trainee. Means? "I want to limit to one registration per day per authenticated user" Means is limit to one registration. Yes. Though maybe requested functionality not from trainee? But means identifiable.

Role yes. Means: have admin view helps track registration status. Yes. Duplicate so that no issue.

BC-008: As a attendee, I want to be added to a training waitlist, so that so they can be considered for a class.
Role yes. Means: be added to waitlist. Yes.

BC-009: As a trainee, I want to must accept the cancellation terms with a checkbox, so that they can be accountable..
Role yes. Means: accept cancellation terms with checkbox. "must accept" maybe weird but means identifiable. Yes.

BC-010: As a trainingcoordinator, I want to tie in a cancellation deadline to whatever registration / cancellation workflow exists, so that so we don't loose money or spots.
Role yes. Means yes.

BC-011: As a trainee, I want to add to "my schedule" if there is a schedule feature on the site, so that they can schedule their event experience.
Role yes. Means: add to "my schedule" yes.
